question: Which of the following cricketers has written the autobiography titled ‘At the Close of Play’?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ricky Ponting**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Ricky Ponting**, the former Australian cricket captain, authored the autobiography titled **'At the Close of Play'**.
 
• The book was released in **2013** and provides an in-depth look into Ponting's illustrious cricket career.
 
• Ricky Ponting is one of the most successful captains in cricket history, leading Australia to numerous victories including **two World Cup wins** in 2003 and 2007.
 
• The autobiography covers his personal and professional life, including his early years, rise to fame, and insights into the world of cricket.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Ricky Ponting's Career Highlights:**

 
 
• Ricky Ponting scored over **27,000 international runs** across Test and ODI formats.
 
• He is the second highest run-scorer in Test cricket history, only behind Sachin Tendulkar.
 
• Ponting has played **168 Test matches**, amassing 13,378 runs with an average of 51.85.
 
• In ODIs, he scored 13,704 runs in 375 matches with an average of 42.03.
 
 
 
• **Australian Cricket Team Achievements:**
 
 
• Under Ponting's captaincy, Australia won **48 out of 77 Test matches**, a winning percentage of 62.3.
 
• Australia also secured **165 ODI wins** under his leadership, including a record **34 consecutive wins** in World Cup matches.
 
 
 
• **Impact on Cricket:**
 
 
• Ricky Ponting's aggressive yet strategic approach to the game significantly influenced modern cricket.
 
• He played a crucial role in the development of young Australian cricketers and remains an influential figure in cricket coaching and commentary.
